# Part II: The Framework

> *"In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But in practice, there is."*
>
> — Yogi Berra (often attributed)

> *"The Political Entropy Index bridges that gap, providing a practical framework grounded in theoretical rigor."*
>
> — Adapted for this framework

Part II introduces the **core of the book**: the Political Entropy Index framework. While Part I established the theoretical foundations, Part II provides the practical toolkit for measuring, analyzing, and understanding political entropy.

The chapters in this part explore each of the six dimensions in depth, explain the weighting logic, demonstrate the calculation methodology, and show how to apply the framework to real-world analysis.
